newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Newcourt Credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Newcourt Credit ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service on Thursday said it confirmed the long- and short-term ratings of Newcourt Credit Group Inc with a stable trend.
The bond rating agency confirmed the ratings after Newcourt said it has entered an agreement to purchase Commcorp Financial Services Inc.

DBRS confirmed Newcourt's senior debt at A (low) and commercial paper at R-1 (low) with a stable trend. The rating agency also confirmed the commercial paper of Newcourt Credit Group USA Inc at R-1 (low) with a stable trend.
While the acquisition will present short-term challenges on issues such as integration and impose significant demands on senior management time, DBRS said there are numerous positive considerations.

These positives include that fact that because Newcourt plans to issue new equity, leverage ratios will remain virtually unchanged at very conservative levels. Other positives cited by DBRS include the fact that the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce will shift its ownership interest in Commcorp to Newcourt.
The merger will strengthen Newcourt's already solid position in the Canadian commercial financial market and it is a good fit, DBRS said.

It added that the merger is expected to result in meaningful economy of scale cost benefits, adds a base of experienced staff for Newcourt's ongoing expansion plans and presents potential opportunities to expand some of Commcorp's vendor relationships outside of Canada.
